passages.text: Financial Condition and Results of Operations The MD&A is intended to provide a narrative description of the Company’s business from management’s perspective, which includes an overview of Ovintiv’s consolidated 2025 results and year-over-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024 results. This MD&A should be read in conjunction with the audited Consolidated Financial Statements and accompanying notes for the year ended December 31, 2025 (“Consolidated Financial Statements”), which are included in Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Discussion and analysis of 2023 results and year-over-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 results that are not included in this Form 10-K, can be found in Item 7 of the 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K. Common industry terms and abbreviations are used throughout this MD&A and are defined in the Definitions, Conversions and Conventions sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This MD&A includes the following sections: • Executive Overview • Results of Operations • Liquidity and Capital Resources • Accounting Policies and Estimates • Non-GAAP Measures Execu tive Overview Strategy Ovintiv aims to be a leading North American energy producer and is focused on developing its high-quality multi-basin portfolio of oil and natural gas producing plays as part of its strategy outlined in Items 1 and 2 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Ovintiv is committed to delivering quality returns from its capital investment, generating significant cash flows and providing durable cash returns to its shareholders through the commodity price cycle. The Company aims to achieve its strategic priorities through execution excellence, disciplined capital allocation, and commercial acumen and risk management. In addition, the Company is dedicated to driving progress in the area of sustainability, aligning with its commitment to corporate responsibility. In support of the Company’s commitment to enhancing shareholder value, Ovintiv utilizes its shareholder return framework to provide competitive returns to shareholders while strengthening its balance sheet. Ovintiv continually monitors and evaluates changing market conditions to maximize cash flows, mitigate risks and renew its premium well inventory. The Company’s high-quality assets, located in the United States and Canada, form a multi-basin, multi-product portfolio which enables flexible and efficient investment of capital that supports the Company’s strategy. Ovintiv seeks to deliver results in a socially and environmentally responsible manner. Best practices are deployed across its assets, allowing the Company to capitalize on operational efficiencies and decrease emissions intensity. The Company’s sustainability reporting, which outlines its key metrics, targets and relative progress achieved, can be found in the Company Outlook section of this MD&A and on the Company’s sustainability website. Underpinning Ovintiv’s strategy are core values of one, agile, innovative and driven, which guide the organization to be collaborative, responsive, flexible and determined. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably funds capital spending plus shareholder distributions, leaving genuine free cash flow after the dividend and buyback programme. This internally funded model reduces reliance on external borrowing to sustain the capital programme through the commodity cycle.

Gross leverage sits modestly above the sector median and rose year over year, yet remains inside the lowest indicative risk band with only a thin cushion to the next boundary. Debt has been reduced steadily across the trend period, supporting the balance sheet narrative in the filing.

key_risks.text: Interest coverage has deteriorated year over year and sits well below the sector median, reflecting a comparatively heavy gross interest burden relative to operating income. Coverage remains adequate but the gap to peers signals less resilience if operating income weakens with commodity prices.

The filing flags commodity price exposure and the need to renew premium well inventory as core risks; operating margin has compressed year over year and trails the sector median. Earnings sensitivity to oil and gas prices is the dominant driver of cash-flow volatility for this multi-basin producer.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Cash flow coverage of debt is above the sector median and improved year over year, and free cash flow to debt also strengthened, though it remains marginally below the peer median. Debt service looks comfortably met from recurring operating cash generation rather than asset sales.

The maturity ladder is manageable, with a modest near-term instalment and the bulk of principal deferred beyond year five, while cash on hand is minimal. Refinancing depends on continued access to debt markets and sustained cash generation rather than a liquidity buffer.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is Minimal, anchored by leverage inside the lowest band and strong cash-flow coverage of debt. Headroom to the next leverage boundary is thin, so a modest EBITDA decline or incremental debt would shift the profile; this is analyst judgement, not a rating.

We view the credit as solidly investment-grade in character: self-funded capital and distributions, declining debt and a long-dated maturity profile offset weaker coverage and margin versus peers. Watch commodity-driven earnings volatility and the narrow leverage cushion as the key monitoring variables.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流充裕地覆蓋資本開支加上股東分派，在股息及回購計劃後仍留下真正的自由現金流。此內部融資模式減少對外部借貸的依賴，以維持資本計劃渡過商品週期。
總槓桿略高於行業中位數並按年上升，但仍處於最低指示性風險區間內，僅距下一界限有狹窄緩衝。債務在趨勢期內穩步減少，支持申報文件中的資產負債表論述。

key_risks.text: 利息覆蓋率按年惡化，並遠低於行業中位數，反映相對營運收入而言總利息負擔較重。覆蓋率仍屬足夠，但與同業的差距顯示若營運收入隨商品價格轉弱，韌性較低。
申報文件將商品價格敞口及需要更新優質井庫存列為核心風險；營運利潤率按年壓縮並落後於行業中位數。盈利對油氣價格的敏感度是這家多盆地生產商現金流波動的主要驅動因素。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 債務的現金流覆蓋率高於行業中位數並按年改善，自由現金流對債務的比率亦增強，儘管仍略低於同業中位數。債務償付看來可從經常性營運現金產生而非資產出售中從容滿足。
到期結構可控，近期到期款項適度，大部分本金延至五年後，而手頭現金極少。再融資依賴持續進入債務市場及持續現金產生，而非流動性緩衝。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為極低，錨定於槓桿處於最低區間內及強勁的債務現金流覆蓋率。距下一槓桿界限的餘裕狹窄，因此EBITDA適度下降或增量債務將改變該狀況；此為分析師判斷，並非評級。
我們認為該信用在特質上屬穩健的投資級：自籌資本及分派、債務下降及長年期到期結構，抵銷了相對同業較弱的覆蓋率及利潤率。關注商品驅動的盈利波動及狹窄的槓桿緩衝，作為主要監察變數。
